title: Bubble Tails, Actor Anchoring & Readability Assistance
objective: Bind optional speech/thought balloon tails to governed actor or anchor references and provide collision/readability warnings and suggestions without silently rewriting authored text, text geometry, actor truth or panel composition.
acceptance: Bubble tails are optional presentation-only geometry bound to an existing SAA-09 text element and a governed actor/anchor reference; they never create or mutate canonical actor, Character/NPC/Creature or Scene relationships.
Actor anchoring preserves stable actor/owner identity from prior SAA actor projection contracts and fails closed when the target actor/anchor is missing, stale, unavailable or incompatible.
Tail geometry remains bounded to the target panel/composition and does not silently rewrite SAA-09 text geometry, SAA-03 composition bounds or panel reading order.
Collision and readability analysis produces explicit warnings/suggestions only; it may not silently move, resize, reflow, truncate or rewrite authored dialogue/text/layout.
Readability checks retain actual readable text state and report issues such as overlap, tail crossing, off-panel placement or insufficient separation without rasterizing canonical text.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can inspect, create, remove, retarget and adjust tails/anchors and review warnings without requiring drag gestures.
Provider-off local operation is supported; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-11 and later text/lettering/export/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-10 owns presentation-only tail/anchor/readability-assistance state; Character/NPC/Creature, Dialogue/Narrative and Scene owner domains retain canonical truth.
Warnings and suggestions are advisory only and cannot silently alter authored text, text geometry, actor projection, panel geometry, reading order or source-domain state.
No automatic semantic rewriting, translation, speech generation, export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
SAA-11 remains blocked until verified SAA-10 closeout.
